name: bond-marginal-and-neutron-chain
description: Marginal (not average) bond energy for the pure-proton and pure-neutron chains at A = 2,3,4 by the column-sparse Schur-Weyl route, and the relative-decline discriminator for whether the B_pp decline measured in qou-gcmn carries charge information.
scope: (a) scope-limited measurement; nothing refuted, nothing wired

assertions.name: machinery validated on the pp leg against the committed value
assertions.detail: The nn leg has no committed twin, so this is the only anchor the construction has; it is the same anchor the previous probe used.

assertions.name: same crossing COUNT and same bond count; the words differ by a one-for-one sigma <-> sigma_inv trade
assertions.detail: If the two words agreed, B_nn would equal B_pp identically and the charge question could not be asked. MEASURED: the 'averaged' count is IDENTICAL on the two chains at every A; the entire difference is sigma traded for sigma_inv, one for one. That is the p -> sigma, n -> sigma_inv identification appearing as a measurement. Both chains also toggle exactly A-1 crossings under include_inter, so the per-bond divisor is the same object on both legs.

assertions.name: the marginal bond declines FASTER than the reported average, on both chains
assertions.detail: The previously reported 13.0 % pp drop is a running mean of a faster-moving quantity. The marginal is what an assembly model needs; the average is what was published in the previous probe.

assertions.name: the relative decline profile is reported, and its verdict stated explicitly rather than left to the reader
assertions.detail: max separation 0.360499; verdict = SEPARATE profiles (charge-bearing). This check records the measurement; it does not assert a direction, because either outcome is informative.

assertions.name: the nn/pp bond ratio crosses 1 inside the measured range
assertions.detail: nn/pp = 1.1443476 at A=2, 0.67014545 at A=4. A single multiplicative charge factor on the bond cannot produce a ratio that changes SIDE of 1; whatever distinguishes the two species is A-dependent, not a constant.

assertions.name: scope stated before the conclusion, not after
assertions.detail: Pure chains, three points, one anchored leg, no extrapolation.
